module TopModule (
    input  wire       clk,
    input  wire       reset,
    input  wire       slowena,
    output reg  [3:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 4'd0;
        end else if (slowena) begin
            if (q == 4'd9) begin
                q <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                q <= q + 4'd1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
